settings.relation: Dany Rud is a dedicated handpan artist, musician, and teacher who has immersed himself in the art of the handpan. A self-taught musician, Dany discovered his passion for music through improvisation. His journey with the handpan began in 2019, when he first touched the instrument and experienced a life-changing moment as its sound and vibrations resonated through his body.
settings.quote: Ayasa has transformed my life. Ever since I discovered the handpan, Ayasa has been at the top of my list. I always envisioned myself playing one of their instruments and experiencing the unique feel they offer. This dream started to become a reality in 2023 when I met the team at Ayasa Instruments headquarters. My admiration, respect, and gratitude for them are immeasurable. Their craftsmanship is on another level and continues to improve every day. For me, Ayasa are the best handpan makers in the world, and it is a great honour to play and showcase their instruments to the world.
settings.relation_more:
This special moment set him on a path to share the beautiful vibrations of the handpan worldwide.

Dany travels the globe, teaching the art of the handpan and spreading its calming sounds. He has taught over 100 students and performed on international stages, from Bali, Indonesia, to various countries in Europe. His mission is to instil relaxation and mental tranquillity in the hearts and souls of those he meets.

Originally an electronic sound producer, Dany transitioned to acoustic instruments, exploring the djembe, congas, darbuka, tombak, and other drum percussions. His unique handpan style, influenced by classical piano, provokes a diverse range of emotions. Each time he plays the handpan, his aim is to deeply dive into himself and discover his inner self through sound, allowing listeners to feel that energy.

Dany is currently working on several projects that blend electronic soundscapes with the handpans unique tones. Stay tuned for these exciting new endeavours.
